expected_root_cause: Redirect.Back accepts the Referer header as a redirect location without validating its origin. A cross-origin absolute Referer is therefore reflected into the Location header and creates an open redirect.
fix_summary: Parse the Referer and reject invalid or cross-origin locations, falling back to the supplied local path; add same-origin, cross-origin, relative, and scheme validation tests.
curation_notes: PR #4370 introduces same-origin validation for Redirect.Back and regression tests for cross-origin and scheme-only Referer values.
